messages:
Priya S.: FYI customer 'MapleAI' reporting a spike of 503s + timeouts from hosted inference starting ~08:12 UTC. They say 'upstream process exited' in responses and ~30% of requests now 504. Impacting webhooks.
Alex M.: Can you paste the error payload or a sample request id?
Priya S.:
Customer provided log snippet: ```
2026-03-17T08:12:34Z ERROR upstream: process exited, signal 6
2026-03-17T08:12:34Z ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-17T08:12:34Z WARN container: restart count=3
```
They also sent a curl repro: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"open-16b", "prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate`
Mei L.: Sounds like GPU OOM + crash loop. Which model variant are they on? open-16b likely heavy. Any recent rollout?
Priya S.: They were pinned to `open-16b/q4_0` and we rolled a tiny runtime patch on that pool at 07:50 UTC. Not sure if related.
eng-oncall-bot: Auto-alert -> incident created: INC-20260317-142. Notified eng-sre and eng-runtime.
Alex M.: I can pull the runner logs for their pool. @Mei can you check kernel OOM vs allocator OOM? If allocator, might be KV prefetch or batch growth.
Mei L.: On it. Early check: logs show repeated prefetch requests in quick succession before OOM. There's also `kvcache_corrupt=1` events around the crash. Could be prefetch memory leak + fragmentation.
Jorge R.: If kv cache corruption is possible, that could cause sudden allocation spikes. Can we repro locally with smaller GPU and same workload?
Alex M.: Repro plan: 1) Spin up a small worker with same model + quant profile 2) Run their curl loop at QPS they reported (50rps) 3) Enable `REDWOOD_PREFETCH=1` and `KV_PREFETCH_THREADS=8` to mimic.
Mei L.: Quick mitigation: route the customer's traffic to fallback `open-7b` until we have a patch. Also disable prefetch for their pool: set `KV_PREFETCH_ENABLED=false` on pool config. That should reduce mem pressure.
Priya S.: Customer accepted fallback, but asked for ETA. Can we get a hotfix window?
Alex M.: If it's a prefetch leak, we can ship a targeted hotfix to clamp prefetch batch sizes and bump `CUDA_ALLOC_RETRY=1` in runtime. I'll prepare a canary patch to a single pool.
eng-oncall-bot: Deploy started to pool `hosted-pool-12` (canary) at 08:45 UTC.
Mei L.: Canary logs: prefetch rate limited and allocator stabilizes. No OOM after 20m of test traffic. Looks promising.
Jorge R.: Root cause hypothesis: prefetch code path didn't account for concurrent reentrant prefetch after KV corruption -> double-alloc loop -> GPU OOM -> runtime crash. Need fix in KV prefetch concurrency and add guard for `kvcache_corrupt` state.
Alex M.: Action items: (1) hotfix to cap prefetch concurrency + guard (PR 5123), (2) rollback runtime patch if the canary fails, (3) route affected customer to fallback + share incident notes. I'll open the PR and request review from @Mei.
Priya S.: I'll update customer: we routed to open-7b temporarily, collecting additional logs, ETA for hotfix in ~60-90m. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Mei L.: PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pull/5123. Tests added to simulate kv corruption path.
Alex M.: Merged & deploying hotfix to remaining pools now. Will monitor.
eng-oncall-bot: Deployment finished at 09:38 UTC. No further 503 spikes for the customer's pool in the last 30m.
Priya S.: Customer confirms reduced errors and improved latency. Closing for now; will attach repro artifacts and postmortem once we validate root cause.
